metaTitle: Custom Heart Lapel Pins | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom heart lapel pins for your next event or promotion. Fast turnaround and bulk pricing from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Heart-shaped lapel pins add a personal touch that standard circle or square pins cannot match. Whether you are recognizing employee service milestones, promoting a charity run, or celebrating a company anniversary, the heart shape immediately conveys appreciation and care. Available in soft enamel or printed finishes, these pins can be decorated with your logo and custom colors in sizes from 1 to 1.5 inches. Perfect for HR directors and marketing teams who want their message to stand out with genuine warmth.
heroAltText: Custom heart lapel pins in soft enamel finish with a company logo, available in various sizes for bulk orders.
